/* ======= 한옥 이미지 URL — 여기만 본인 주소로 교체 ======= */ :root{ --hanok-img: url('data:image/webp;base64,'); }
/* ======= TOKENS ======= */ :root{ --pink:#C94F5D; --pink-deep:#993743; --pink-50:#FFF0F1; --dancheong-red:#C94F5D; --dancheong-blue:#1E6F8C; --celadon:#8FB9A8; --hanji:#FBF7EF; --gold:#C49A47; --inkstone:#1D2630; --band1:#F7E9D6; --band2:#E6F0EA; --band-ink:#18242B; --band-sub:#665141; --blue:#1E6F8C; --navy:#18242B; --bg:#FBF7EF; --surface:#ffffff; --ink:#18242B; --body:#39434A; --muted:#68747A; --faint:#9B9286; --border:#E7DCCB; --line:#DED3C2; --shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(48,38,25,.06); --shadow-lg:0 14px 40px rgba(48,38,25,.13); --radius:12px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){ :root:not([data-theme="light"]){ --pink:#E47C84; --pink-deep:#F2A1A7; --pink-50:rgba(228,124,132,.14); --dancheong-red:#E47C84; --dancheong-blue:#7FB7C9; --celadon:#9FC8B8; --hanji:#191815; --gold:#D5B66D; --inkstone:#F4EFE4; --band1:#201B17; --band2:#172126; --band-ink:#F4EFE4; --band-sub:#D6BDA1; --blue:#7FB7C9; --navy:#0F1518; --bg:#151411; --surface:#211F1A; --ink:#F4EFE4; --body:#D8D0C3; --muted:#AAA094; --faint:#82786F; --border:#39342B; --line:#453D33; --shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.3); --shadow-lg:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45); }} :root[data-theme="dark"]{ --pink:#E47C84; --pink-deep:#F2A1A7; --pink-50:rgba(228,124,132,.14); --dancheong-red:#E47C84; --dancheong-blue:#7FB7C9; --celadon:#9FC8B8; --hanji:#191815; --gold:#D5B66D; --inkstone:#F4EFE4; --band1:#201B17; --band2:#172126; --band-ink:#F4EFE4; --band-sub:#D6BDA1; --blue:#7FB7C9; --navy:#0F1518; --bg:#151411; --surface:#211F1A; --ink:#F4EFE4; --body:#D8D0C3; --muted:#AAA094; --faint:#82786F; --border:#39342B; --line:#453D33; --shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.3); --shadow-lg:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45); }
/* ======= BASE ======= */ *{box-sizing:border-box} body{margin:0;background: radial-gradient(circle at 12px 12px, rgba(196,154,71,.08) 1px, transparent 1.2px) 0 0/28px 28px, linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg),#fffaf1 520px,var(--bg)); color:var(--body);font:400 16px/1.75 'Pretendard',-apple-system,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;transition:background .25s,color .25s} a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none} img{max-width:100%;display:block} h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.01em} .wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
/* ======= TOP NAV ======= */ .topbar{background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);backdrop-filter:saturate(160%) blur(14px);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20} .topbar .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px 24px;gap:16px} .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px} .brand .tile{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #E9D8BF;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(196,154,71,.18);flex-shrink:0} :root[data-theme="dark"] .brand .tile,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .brand .tile{background:var(--surface);border-color:var(--line)} .brand .name{font:800 19px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .brand .name span{font-weight:500} .nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px} .nav a{font:700 15px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .tools{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;font:600 13px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--body)} .tools .ic{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer} .theme-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;background:var(--pink-50);border-radius:999px;padding:3px;cursor:pointer} .theme-toggle span{width:24px;height:22px;border-radius:999px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--faint)} .theme-toggle .on{background:var(--pink);color:#fff} .hamburger{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;width:24px;cursor:pointer} .hamburger span{height:2px;background:var(--ink);border-radius:2px}
/* ======= HERO BAND ======= */ .hero{position:relative;background: linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(196,154,71,.22),transparent 32%), radial-gradient(circle at 84% 18%,rgba(30,111,140,.16),transparent 26%), linear-gradient(180deg,var(--band1),var(--band2));overflow:hidden;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(196,154,71,.2)} .hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:7px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--dancheong-red) 0 20%,var(--dancheong-blue) 20% 40%,var(--gold) 40% 60%,var(--celadon) 60% 80%,var(--dancheong-red) 80% 100%)} .hero .wrap{position:relative;padding:58px 24px 68px} .hero .hanok{position:absolute;right:18px;bottom:0;width:430px;height:92%;background:var(--hanok-img) right bottom/contain no-repeat;opacity:.42;pointer-events:none;filter:saturate(.8)} .hero .crumb{font:600 12px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--band-sub);letter-spacing:.04em} .hero h1{font:800 46px/1.08 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--band-ink);margin:10px 0 0;max-width:680px} .hero .sub{font:600 15px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--band-sub);margin-top:12px;max-width:620px} @media (max-width:680px){ .hero .hanok{width:230px;opacity:.4} .hero h1{font-size:30px} }
/* ======= LAYOUT ======= */ .layout{display:flex;gap:34px;padding:36px 0 48px;align-items:flex-start} .main{flex:1;min-width:0} .sidebar{width:300px;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px;position:sticky;top:24px}
/* ======= CHIPS ======= */ .chips{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:26px} .chip{padding:9px 17px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--body);font:600 12px 'Pretendard',sans-serif} .chip.active{background:var(--ink);color:var(--hanji);border-color:var(--ink)}
/* ======= FEATURED ======= */ .featured{position:relative;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;height:350px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);margin-bottom:34px;display:block;border:1px solid rgba(196,154,71,.28)} .featured .ph{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F0D6B7,#DDEBE4 52%,#E7F0F4)} .featured .ph:after{content:"Korea travel field guide";position:absolute;right:24px;bottom:20px;color:rgba(24,36,43,.42);font:800 24px 'Pretendard',sans-serif} .featured img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover} .featured .scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(31,36,48,.66),rgba(31,36,48,0) 62%)} .featured .ct{position:absolute;left:38px;bottom:34px;right:38px;max-width:600px} .featured .ft-tag{display:inline-block;padding:6px 13px;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--dancheong-red),var(--dancheong-blue));color:#fff;font:700 11px 'Pretendard',sans-serif} .featured h2{font:800 34px/1.16 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:#fff;margin:12px 0 0} .featured .fm{font:600 12px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);margin-top:10px}
/* ======= SECTION TITLE ======= */ .sec{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;margin:0 0 18px} .sec h2{font:800 23px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);margin:0} .sec .all{font:700 13px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--dancheong-blue)}
/* ======= CARDS ======= */ .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px} .card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .18s,border-color .18s} .card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(30,111,140,.14);border-color:#D5C19B} .card:hover .card-t{color:var(--pink-deep)} .thumb{height:168px;position:relative;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F0D6B7,#E3EFE8);overflow:hidden} .thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover} .tag{position:absolute;left:12px;top:12px;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:7px;background:rgba(24,36,43,.82);color:#fff;font:700 9px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase} .card-b{padding:17px 18px 18px} .card-t{font:700 17px/1.32 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);transition:color .15s} .card-x{font:400 13px/1.6 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px} .card-m{font:500 11px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--faint);margin-top:12px}
/* ======= SIDEBAR ======= */ .widget{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative;overflow:hidden} .w-title{font:700 11px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dancheong-blue);margin-bottom:14px} .w-about .stripe{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:5px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--dancheong-red),var(--gold),var(--dancheong-blue))} .w-about .tile{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:13px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #E9D8BF;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-top:6px} :root[data-theme="dark"] .w-about .tile,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .w-about .tile{background:var(--bg)} .w-about h3{font:800 16px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;margin:12px 0 0} .w-about p{font:400 12.5px/1.65 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--muted);margin:7px 0 0} .popular .it{display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:flex-start;padding:8px 0} .popular .n{display:inline-block;min-width:30px;flex:0 0 30px;white-space:nowrap;font:800 17px/1.2 'Pretendard',sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--gold);text-align:left} .popular .t{font:700 13px/1.35 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .cats a{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font:600 13.5px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--body)} .cats a:last-child{border-bottom:0} .cats .c{color:var(--faint);font-size:11px} .searchw{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:8px 8px 8px 16px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius)} .searchw input{border:0;background:transparent;outline:none;font:600 13px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);width:100%} .searchw input::placeholder{color:var(--faint)} .searchw button{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--dancheong-blue);border:0;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
/* ======= POST ======= */ .postcard{position:relative;margin:-40px auto 0;max-width:820px;background:var(--surface);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);padding:26px 32px;border:1px solid var(--border)} .postcard .head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap} .postcard h1{font:800 30px/1.18 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);margin:0} .postcard .ksub{font:500 14px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px} .postcard .meta{font:600 12px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--faint);white-space:nowrap;padding-top:6px} .ptags{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px} .ptags a{padding:7px 15px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);font:600 12px 'Pretendard',sans-serif} .post-body{max-width:720px;margin:30px auto 0;font:400 18px/1.85 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--body);overflow-wrap:anywhere} .post-body p{margin:0 0 18px} .post-body h2{font:800 24px/1.3 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);margin:32px 0 14px} .post-body h3{font:800 20px/1.35 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);margin:26px 0 12px} .post-body a{color:var(--dancheong-blue);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px} .post-body img{max-width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:14px;margin:22px 0} .post-body table{display:block;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;border-collapse:collapse} .post-body th,.post-body td{min-width:150px;word-break:normal} .post-body ul,.post-body ol{padding-left:22px;margin:0 0 18px} .post-body blockquote{margin:24px 0;border-left:4px solid var(--dancheong-red);background:var(--pink-50);border-radius:0 14px 14px 0;padding:16px 20px;font-size:16px}
/* ======= PAGER / FOOTER ======= */ .pager{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin:34px 0 0} .pager a{padding:10px 22px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);font:700 13px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:var(--body)} .foot{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#18242B,#213D45);color:rgba(255,255,255,.84);border-top:6px solid var(--gold)} :root[data-theme="dark"] .foot,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .foot{background:#0F0E13} .foot .wrap{padding:30px 24px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;font:500 13px 'Pretendard',sans-serif} .foot .fb{font:800 18px 'Pretendard',sans-serif;color:#fff}
/* ======= RESPONSIVE ======= */ @media (max-width:980px){ .layout{flex-direction:column} .sidebar{width:100%;position:static;flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap} .sidebar>*{flex:1;min-width:240px} } @media (max-width:680px){ .wrap{padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px} .nav{display:none} .hamburger{display:flex} .layout{gap:22px}.main,.blog-main,.widget.Blog,.postcard,.post-body{width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;margin-left:0!important;margin-right:0!important}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr} .featured{height:auto;min-height:260px} .sidebar{flex-direction:column} .sidebar>*{min-width:0} .postcard{padding:20px 18px}.postcard h1{font-size:24px}.post-body{font-size:16px;line-height:1.75}.post-body table{font-size:14px} } .quickedit,.widget-item-control{display:none}
